info.title: Order Manager API
info.description: Mode C API of the Order Manager (Ecommerce Helper, SSPS v1). sk_ keys (servers) read and change orders; pk_ keys read public metadata, look up tracking and — with a verified SS-Identity — the customer's own orders. Money is integer minor units of each order's currency.
